activity_summary: The barge and the companies' streamers were past a working boatman. At the edge a woman's dark head was turned away, laughing. You did not look long enough to know who stood beside her.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: attendee in Streamers, and a head turned away

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Worked the boat at the near edge of the show.

entities.name: the lady of the parish
entities.context: Turned away, laughing, and was not named.

facets.activity: Saw the barge and a woman's dark head turned away
